children: DOW LEADS AS INVESTORS ROTATE INTO VALUE
The Dow led US stocks higher while the Nasdaq was flat on Tuesday as investors rotated into value stocks such as healthcare and real estate while technology lagged.

The quarterly earnings season is in full swing with earnings reports from SpaceX <SPCX.O> and Netflix <NFLX.O>, after the market close. SpaceX was good, Netflix less so. Meta and Tesla <TSLA.O> are scheduled to report on Wednesday.
Semiconductors fell, with the PHLX Semiconductor Index
down 0.3%. The index had snapped an eight-session losing streak on Monday, its longest since an eight-day skid during the 2008 financial crisis.
Nine of 11 of the S&P 500 sectors gained led by healthcare
shares were the biggest drag on the day as investors pulled back from the AI trade.
Here is a snapshot of where markets stood shortly after 4 p.m. ET.
Dow rallies ~1%, S&P 500 rises 0.28%, Nasdaq flat
Healthcare leads S&P 500 sector gainers; Communication Services weakest group
Dollar, gold dip; US crude up slightly; bitcoin rises ~1%
US 10-year Treasury yield edges down to ~5.11%
